input: Check whether the ORI vendor portal session is usable. Report cookie freshness, cooldown state, and whether credentials are configured — do not file or update any tickets.
expected_behavior: Should run dc-support-cli auth-status --vendor ori (prefer --json for structured output). Report session usability, cookie age/freshness, and credential source metadata. Read-only inspection only — no ticket creation or comments.

input: List the 5 most recent open ORI support tickets. Report the count and each ticket's id, summary, and status. Keep the limit small to minimize tokens.
expected_behavior: Should call list_vendor_tickets with vendor ori, status open, and a small limit (5). Summarize returned tickets — must not create, comment on, or update any ticket.

input: Which vendors are configured for dc-support-cli? List each vendor and whether credentials are set (source metadata only — never print secret values).
expected_behavior: Should run dc-support-cli vendors to show configured vendors and credential source (env vs op://). Passive credential inspection only — no portal mutations.
